Kenalkan Louie Buana, yang menulis sejarah kembali ke kehidupan.

Seorang penulis Indonesia dan peneliti sejarah di Institut Sejarah, Universitas Leiden, Louie menggali cerita-cerita yang coba dihapuskan oleh kolonialisme. Karyanya mencakup hukum adat, jaringan maritim Asia Tenggara, dan kehidupan-kehidupan yang jatuh di antara kekaisaran.

Tetapi Louie tidak hanya menerbitkan di jurnal akademis. Sejak 2011, dia telah membawa epik La Galigo kepada generasi muda melalui Proyek Lontara, sebuah komunitas pemuda yang melestarikan harta karun Sulawesi Selatan ini sebagai Memori Dunia UNESCO.

Louie membangun kesadaran dengan menghidupkan sejarah yang terlupakan.

Sejarah apa yang memberi Anda harapan?

Established by Tim Olsen in 1993, the gallery has built a reputation for championing artists at every stage of their careers, from emerging voices to some of Australia's most celebrated contemporary practitioners.

Dian Purnomo documents what power prefers to hide.

An Indonesian writer and researcher dedicated to exposing the exploitation of girls in Puncak, Dian turns fieldwork into fiction. Her novel Mawar, Bukan Nama Sebenarnya is a social critique born from years spent researching violence against women and children. She has studied child sexual exploitation, worked with marginalized women facing the law, and built her writing on the responsibility to bear witness.

Dian reminds us that empathy demands we listen to the stories that make us uncomfortable.

What human story has changed you?

Dian Purnomo mendokumentasikan apa yang lebih suka disembunyikan oleh kekuasaan.

Seorang penulis dan peneliti Indonesia yang berdedikasi untuk mengungkap eksploitasi perempuan muda di Puncak, Dian mengubah pekerjaan lapangan menjadi fiksi. Novelnya Mawar, Bukan Nama Sebenarnya adalah kritik sosial yang lahir dari bertahun-tahun meneliti kekerasan terhadap perempuan dan anak-anak. Dia telah mempelajari eksploitasi seksual anak, bekerja dengan perempuan terpinggir yang menghadapi hukum, dan membangun tulisannya atas tanggung jawab untuk menjadi saksi.

Dian mengingatkan kita bahwa empati menuntut kita untuk mendengarkan cerita-cerita yang membuat kita tidak nyaman.

David Lindenmayer helps us see the forest for what it truly is.

An Australian Professor and world-leading expert in forest and woodland ecology and conservation biology, David has maintained some of the largest long-term research programmes in Australia, with some spanning over 43 years. His work spans logging impacts, wildfire, plantation design, and how multiple disturbances combine to reshape entire ecosystems. Among the world’s most highly-cited scientists, he has published 50 books and over 1,500 scientific articles, turning decades of fieldwork into evidence that helps protect what remains.

Lindenmayer’s research reminds us that awareness is the foundation every act of conservation is built on.

What do you wish more people understood about our forests?

David Lindenmayer membantu kita melihat hutan sebagaimana adanya.

Seorang Profesor asal Australia dan pakar terkemuka dunia dalam ekologi hutan dan hutan gundul serta biologi konservasi, David telah menjalankan beberapa program penelitian jangka panjang terbesar di Australia, beberapa di antaranya berlangsung lebih dari 43 tahun. Karyanya mencakup dampak penebangan, kebakaran hutan, desain perkebunan, serta bagaimana berbagai gangguan yang saling berinteraksi mengubah seluruh ekosistem. Sebagai salah satu ilmuwan yang paling banyak dikutip di dunia, ia telah menerbitkan 50 buku dan lebih dari 1.500 artikel ilmiah, mengubah puluhan tahun kerja lapangan menjadi bukti nyata yang membantu melindungi apa yang tersisa.

Penelitian Lindenmayer mengingatkan kita bahwa kesadaran adalah fondasi dari setiap upaya konservasi.

Apa yang kamu harap lebih banyak orang pahami tentang hutan kita?

From a single Sydney gallery to an international network spanning Australia and Berlin, Michael Reid has never stood still.

Over the past 25 years, the gallery has built a reputation for championing Australian contemporary art across painting, photography and First Nations practice, while continually finding new ways to connect artists with audiences at home and abroad.

A long-standing exhibitor at Sydney Contemporary, Michael Reid Sydney + Berlin has participated in every edition of the Fair since 2013, and this year returns to Sydney Contemporary with its most ambitious presentation to date.

At the heart of the booth is a monumental suspended installation by Wynne Prize winner Gaypalani Waṉambi, joined by new works from celebrated First Nations artists Betty Chimney and Regina Pilawuk Wilson. The presentation also features new paintings, sculpture and photography by leading Australian artists, including Tim Maguire, Stephanie Tabram, Troy Emery, Mai Nguyễn-Long, Petrina Hicks, Tamara Dean, Scott Perkins and Murray Fredericks.

What does it take to carry Indonesian literature onto the world stage? Finding the right voices.

This year, 650+ writers from 21 provinces submitted to our Emerging Writers Programme. Ten were selected. They are receiving mentoring, editorial development, and their work will be published in a bilingual anthology launching at #UWRF26.

For many emerging writers, this programme is the moment their career begins.

These ten writers were chosen because someone believed in them. Now we are asking you to do the same. Choose your level of impact and champion the future of Indonesian storytelling: ubudwritersfestival.com/support (or click the link in our bio).

Apa yang diperlukan untuk membawa sastra Indonesia ke panggung dunia? Menemukan suara-suara yang tepat.

Tahun ini, 650+ penulis dari 21 provinsi mengajukan karya mereka ke Program Penulis Emerging kami. Sepuluh telah dipilih. Mereka dibimbing, mengembangkan dan menyunting karya, dan tulisan-tulisan mereka akan diterbitkan dalam antologi dwibahasa yang diluncurkan pada #UWRF26 nanti.

Bagi banyak penulis muda baik dalam usia maupun karya, program ini adalah saat karir mereka dimulai.

Kesepuluh penulis ini dipilih karena seseorang percaya pada mereka. Kini, kami mengajak Anda untuk melakukan hal yang sama. Tentukan bentuk bantuan yang Anda inginkan dan dukung masa depan penceritaan Indonesia mulai dari sini: ubudwritersfestival.com/support (atau ketuk tautan di bio kami).

Randa Abdel-Fattah refuses to be silenced.

An Australian sociologist and award-winning author whose novel Discipline won the Victorian Premier’s People’s Choice Award. Her 2025 work sparked controversy when she was disinvited from Adelaide Writers’ Week, triggering a major boycott. The novel asks: who has the right to tell these stories, and whose voice gets heard? Her research focuses on Muslim activism, Islamophobia, and social movements. She writes from conviction.

Abdel-Fattah knows that action is how we refuse to be silenced.

What does brave storytelling mean to you?

Randa Abdel-Fattah menolak untuk dibungkam.

Novel tersebut bertanya: siapa yang berhak menceritakan kisah-kisah ini, dan suara siapa yang didengar? Penelitiannya fokus pada aktivisme Muslim, Islamofobia, dan gerakan sosial. Dia menulis dari keyakinan.

Abdel-Fattah tahu bahwa tindakan adalah cara kita menolak untuk dibungkam.

A writer deeply rooted in her world, we are excited to welcome Raisa Kamila to #UWRF26.

An Indonesian writer and historical researcher, Kamila weaves together space, infrastructure and sensory perception into fiction that feels entirely her own. Her works Perkara Keramat and Cerita dari Sebelah Masjid Raya, both published in 2024, and her latest non-fiction Tak Naik Suara mark her as one of Indonesia’s most compelling emerging voices.

Between doctoral studies, raising a child, and running the Arisan Buku book club in Banda Aceh since 2018, she has built a literary life from the ground up.

Kamila finds the extraordinary in the overlooked: the history held in buildings, the stories stored in streets, the sounds that carry memory. She reminds us that awareness begins close to home.

Have you ever felt that a place was trying to tell you something?

🔗 Join us this October. More details in bio.
🎟️ Early Bird Passes still on sale, link in bio.

— 

Seorang penulis yang berakar kuat dalam dunianya, kami dengan antusias menyambut Raisa Kamila di #UWRF26.

Penulis dan peneliti sejarah asal Indonesia ini memadukan ruang, infrastruktur, dan persepsi inderawi menjadi fiksi yang terasa sepenuhnya miliknya sendiri. Karya-karyanya, Perkara Keramat dan Cerita dari Sebelah Masjid Raya, keduanya terbit pada 2024, serta non-fiksi terbarunya Tak Naik Suara, menjadikannya salah satu suara baru paling menarik dalam sastra Indonesia.

Di antara studi doktoral, membesarkan anak, dan mengelola klub buku Arisan Buku di Banda Aceh sejak 2018, ia telah membangun kehidupan sastra dari nol.

Kamila menemukan hal luar biasa dalam hal yang sering terlewatkan: sejarah yang tersimpan dalam gedung-gedung, kisah yang tersimpan di jalanan, dan suara-suara yang membawa ingatan. Ia mengingatkan kita bahwa kesadaran bermula dari hal yang dekat.

Pernahkah kamu merasa sebuah tempat sedang mencoba menyampaikan sesuatu kepadamu?

Sebagai mantan direktur Perth Writers Festival, ia telah mewawancarai puluhan penulis, dan kini mengajarkan seni bercerita, baik tulisan maupun lisan, dengan fokus pada biografi dan memoar. Msimang percaya bahwa empati dimulai ketika kisah orang lain terasa nyata bagi kita.

Apa arti menceritakan sebuah kisah yang benar-benar menyentuh hati Anda?

Katie Kitamura deconstructs the roles we play every day.

An American novelist whose latest novel Audition, published April 2025, was shortlisted for the Booker Prize and is a finalist for the 2026 Pulitzer Prize. The novel is structured as a Möbius strip: two competing narratives that rewrite what we think we know. It follows an accomplished actress meeting a troubling young man, asking “whether we ever really know the people we love.”

Kitamura’s spare, clinical prose creates psychological depths that linger long after reading. Named one of Barack Obama’s 2025 summer reads, Audition explores the masks we wear even for those closest to us.

Kitamura reminds us that awareness begins when we stop believing the performance, even our own.

Who would you be if no one was watching?

Kitamura membongkar peran yang kita mainkan setiap hari.

Seorang penulis Amerika yang novelnya terakhir Audition, diterbitkan April 2025, masuk daftar pendek Booker Prize dan menjadi finalis Pulitzer Prize 2026. Novel ini dibangun seperti pita Möbius: dua narasi yang bersaing menulis ulang apa yang kita pikir kita tahu. Ceritanya mengikuti seorang aktris berbakat yang bertemu dengan pria muda yang merepotkan, menanyakan “apakah kita pernah benar-benar mengenal orang-orang yang kita cintai.” 

Prosa ringkas dan klinis Kitamura menciptakan kedalaman psikologis yang bertahan lama setelah membaca. Dinamai salah satu bacaan musim panas 2025 Barack Obama, Audition mengeksplorasi topeng yang kita pakai bahkan untuk mereka yang paling dekat dengan kita.

Kitamura mengingatkan kita bahwa kesadaran dimulai ketika kita berhenti percaya pada pertunjukan, bahkan milik kita sendiri.

Siapa dirimu jika tidak ada yang menonton?

A visionary, a poet, a modernist. Chairil Anwar’s life was short but prolific and impactful. One can only wonder if he didn’t leave us too soon, how his words would have influenced future generations of Indonesia. How his poems would have reached far beyond the archipelago, for his works are certainly a bridge of evolution between classic Indonesian poetry and new forms. Listen to Bayu Lesmana and Pranita Dewi, read Anwar’s poems on his death anniversary.

Anwar left the world on 28 April at the age of 28. In his poem Aku (Me), he says, “I want to live a thousand more years.” The legacy of his poems keeps him alive, and we gather at Indus Restaurant to celebrate him. There will be an open mic segment. We encourage you to bring your poems written inspired by Chairil Anwar or read a poem by him. Take a moment to read his work and write in the spirit of Chairil Anwar, a poet gone too soon.

📅 Date: Tuesday, 28 April
⏰ Time: 19:00-21:00
📍 Location: Indus Restaurant

Next to join us in Ubud: we are delighted to bring Fatima Bhutto to #UWRF26.

Born in Afghanistan, raised in Syria and Pakistan, Bhutto has always written from the crossroads of worlds in conflict. Her debut novel The Shadow of the Crescent Moon announced a voice of rare moral clarity, longlisted for the Women's Prize for Fiction. Since then she has moved fluidly between fiction and non-fiction, from The Runaways to New Kings of the World, never straying far from the lives caught in the undertow of history.

Her most recent book, the memoir The Hour of the Wolf, is her most personal yet.
Bhutto does not write from a safe distance. She writes from inside the places the world would rather reduce to headlines, and she insists on the full humanity of everyone she finds there.

That is empathy in its most courageous form.

We are thrilled to welcome Peter Godwin to #UWRF26.

Born and raised in Zimbabwe, Godwin has lived many lives: human rights lawyer, foreign correspondent for the Sunday Times and the BBC, and one of the most unflinching chroniclers of his country’s unravelling. His books, among them Mukiwa, When a Crocodile Eats the Sun, and The Fear, have earned him the George Orwell Prize and a place on the New Yorker’s best books of the year.

His latest, Exit Wounds: A Story of Love, Loss and Occasional Wars, brings him to Ubud this October.
Godwin writes from inside the wound — documenting suffering, refusing to let the world look away. That is what action looks like on the page.

He will also lead an intimate three-day writing intensive from 18 to 20 October.

Proudly sharing #UWRF26’s first highlight - the inimitable, Kiran Desai. This year she brings her warm, delightful presence and The Loneliness of Sonia and Sunny to Ubud. Her story brings awareness or Citta that forms part of the Sanskrit philosophy of Samarasā — this year’s theme. Samarasā is a blend of three movements: Awareness. Empathy. Action. These are the forces that shape human reasoning. It is a reminder that beneath all difference, we share a common humanity.

Kiran Desai opens that journey. Her Booker Prize-winning The Inheritance of Loss makes visible what the world prefers to ignore — the human cost of colonialism, migration and aspiration. She writes from the in-between, from the margins, from the places most of us look away from.

That is where awareness begins.

Join us this October.

An Indonesian voice like no other, we are so pleased to welcome Valiant Budi, known as Vabyo, to #UWRF26.

A writer with a gift for finding humor in the hardest corners of life, Vabyo first captured hearts with Kedai 1001 Mimpi, a memoir drawn from his years as a migrant worker in Saudi Arabia. His story collection Tukar Takdir has since made it to the screen, and his latest novel Kiamat Kumat turns a sharp, warm eye on Bali’s ‘healer’ phenomenon and the tensions between newcomers and those who have always called it home.

He writes about ordinary people navigating extraordinary circumstances, and he does it with a lightness that makes the truth land harder.

That is the quiet power of seeing clearly and laughing anyway.

Have you ever felt that humour was the only way to get through something difficult?

🔗 Join us this October. More details in bio.
🎟️ Early Bird Passes still on sale, link in bio.

— 

Suara Indonesia yang tak tertandingi, kami dengan senang hati menyambut Valiant Budi, yang dikenal sebagai Vabyo, di #UWRF26.

Seorang penulis dengan kemampuan luar biasa dalam menemukan humor di sudut-sudut kehidupan yang paling berat, Vabyo pertama kali mencuri hati dengan Kedai 1001 Mimpi, sebuah memoar yang lahir dari pengalamannya sebagai pekerja migran di Arab Saudi. Kumpulan ceritanya Tukar Takdir telah diadaptasi ke layar, dan novel terbarunya Kiamat Kumat memandang fenomena ‘penyembuh’ di Bali dengan mata yang tajam sekaligus hangat, menyoroti ketegangan antara pendatang dan mereka yang sudah lama menyebutnya rumah.

Ia menulis tentang orang-orang biasa yang menghadapi keadaan luar biasa, dan melakukannya dengan keringanan yang justru membuat kebenaran terasa lebih dalam.

Itulah kekuatan diam dari melihat dengan jernih dan tetap tertawa.

Pernahkah kamu merasa bahwa humor adalah satu-satunya cara untuk melewati sesuatu yang sulit?

🔗 Bergabunglah bersama kami Oktober ini. Selengkapnya di bio.

An Indonesian journalist, filmmaker and truth-teller, we are proud to welcome Dandhy Laksono to #UWRF26.

Over a 26-year career, he has covered everything from banking scandals in Jakarta to the Aceh military emergency and the 2004 tsunami. In 2009 he founded Watchdoc, which went on to win the Gwangju Prize for Human Rights and the Ramon Magsaysay Award in 2021. He's authored Indonesia for Sale, Jurnalisme Investigasi, and Reset Indonesia, co-written with three colleagues.

But it's his documentaries, from Sexy Killers to Dirty Vote and his latest, Pesta Babi, that have shaken public conversation, unflinchingly examining power, complicity and the stories those in charge would prefer stayed untold.

Dandhy does not look away. That is what it means to turn awareness into action.

🔗 Join us this October. More details in bio.

Since 2008, Handmade has been proudly supporting Australian-made designers and producers 💙 

Starting with just 35 stallholders in 2008, we’ve now grown to be one of Australia’s largest design markets, welcoming 260 stallholders from across the country and supporting more than 550 makers through our online directory. Throughout that growth, community has always remained at the heart of what we do!

From the very beginning, our founder and director Julie created Handmade with a passion for supporting small, Australian-made creative businesses. One of Julie’s priorities was that the event would always be free to enter. Today, we continue to offer free entry and free parking, while also supporting local charities like @riseabovecbr, who collect optional donations at our entry points to provide financial assistance to cancer patients across the Canberra region.

We love what we do and we’re incredibly grateful to every stallholder, shopper and supporter who continues to be part of it 🤗

Introducing our next #UWRF26 highlight: the brilliant Tash Aw.

Tash Aw has spent his literary life navigating the space between different worlds. His debut The Harmony Silk Factory announced a rare voice, one that holds history and intimacy in the same breath. His newest novel, The South, longlisted for both the 2025 Booker Prize and the National Book Critics Circle Award, continues that unflinching excavation of identity, belonging, and the quiet violence of displacement.

Tash Aw writes the lives that fall between national narratives: the migrant, the outsider, the survivor shaped by systems larger than themselves. To read him is to be asked to sit with discomfort, to recognise a shared humanity in the faces the world overlooks.

That is where empathy begins.

Her voice has never wavered. We are honoured to welcome Adania Shibli to #UWRF26.

A Palestinian author and essayist, Shibli writes across novels, plays, short stories and narrative essays with a precision that makes the unbearable visible. Her novel Minor Detail was shortlisted for the National Book Award and nominated for the International Booker Prize, and has reached readers across the world through Fitzcarraldo, New Directions, and Text Publishing.

Her latest work, Tamwih, published in Arabic in 2025, is forthcoming in English as Delusion in 2027.

Shibli writes from a place the world has long tried to silence. Her sentences do not shout; they hold still, and in that stillness, demand to be reckoned with. That is where awareness lives.

What is a book that changed the way you see the world?

Suaranya tidak pernah goyah. Kami merasa terhormat menyambut Adania Shibli di #UWRF26.

Novelnya Minor Detail masuk dalam daftar pendek National Book Award dan dinominasikan untuk International Booker Prize, dan telah menjangkau pembaca di seluruh dunia melalui Fitzcarraldo, New Directions, dan Text Publishing.

Karya terbarunya, Tamwih, diterbitkan dalam bahasa Arab pada 2025, akan segera hadir dalam bahasa Inggris dengan judul Delusion pada 2027.

Shibli menulis dari tempat yang sudah lama coba dibungkam oleh dunia. Kalimat-kalimatnya tidak berteriak; mereka diam, dan dalam keheningan itu, menuntut untuk direnungkan. Di situlah kesadaran tinggal.

Since launching her Rinse residency in 2025, RIRIA’s ascent has been swift. Moving from Tokyo’s cult institutions to some of the world’s most revered stages, including Alexandra Palace, Glastonbury and ADE, she has quickly established herself as an artist capable of bridging scenes, generations and geographies with remarkable ease.

Cruzar el Ma Pi Leng con el cañón a tus pies y quedarte callado, casco en mano, porque ahí ni el "es que no puedo" alcanza.

Llevamos años abriendo caminos: Nepal, Vietnam, Perú, Costa Rica, la Ruta 66, los Alpes… y esta vez el dedo se ha parado en el extremo sur de África.

Sudáfrica es el nuevo destino de Motorbeach Viajes.
Un país que casi nadie asocia con un viaje en moto y que, en cuanto entras en la primera curva, entiendes que llevaba esperándote desde siempre.

 Asfalto impecable, tráfico escaso y un paisaje que cambia cada dos horas: amaneces entre viñedos, comes junto al océano y cenas viendo pasar antílopes.
La Garden Route pegada al Índico. 

La Ruta 62 y el silencio enorme del Karoo. Chapman's Peak y sus 114 curvas colgadas del acantilado. Elefantes y jirafas que no son una excursión aparte, están en la ruta.

Y lo mejor: su verano es nuestro invierno. Salir de España con abrigo y aterrizar en manga corta al día siguiente.

Name another artist who can make a triple-platinum hit and end up in a high-profile grime clash months later. Somebody who can rock a tracksuit and star in a Burberry campaign with equal authenticity; who seems as comfortable behind the production desk as he is on the mic; who commands as much respect in Ibiza DJ booths as he does on a festival main stage. One of Australia's most exciting artists, Alfred Lowe, returns to Sydney Contemporary.

Since receiving the MA Art Prize at Sydney Contemporary in 2024, Lowe has gone on to win the Rigg Prize and be named a finalist in both the Ramsay and Wynne Prizes.

Now, SABBIA presents Lowe's most ambitious body of work to date. Bringing together bold new ceramic and raffia sculptures, the presentation will explore community, individuality and belonging through works that are joyful and expressive, exploring community, individuality and belonging.

SABBIA will also present ‘The Poetry of Things’ a collaboration of intimate wall-based glass works by Blair and Rea alongside Lowe’s work. Bringing together two distinct glass practices, reflecting on the quiet beauty found in the everyday. 

Together, these two exhibitions highlight the remarkable diversity within contemporary Australian ceramics and glass—from the fun and playfulness of Lowe’s bold sculptures to Blair and Rea’s quiet and exquisitely crafted installations.

MENDI TOUR 2025 BURGOS
14 y 15 OCT 📌 Museo de la Evolución Humana
16 OCT 📌 Van Golem Arlanzón
🎬 Tres días de películas de escalada, alpinismo, esquí y Trail running en el MEH y en Vangolem Arlanzón con el Mendi Tour Burgos.
⭐️ Películas internacionales en VOSE, que serán presentadas por el director del Mendi Film, Jabier Baraiazarra.

‘Andrea, un unpaved route’ 
Protagonizada por la escaladora Nina Caprez y el fotógrafo Jérémy Bernard en un viaje de escalada y solidaridad por Marruecos. Fue premiada en el Mendi Film como la Mejor Película de Deporte y Aventura.

‘L’Etá Sperimentale’ 
Recibió en Bilbao el premio a Mejor Guion. Es una película ideada y protagonizada por el famoso escritor y poeta italiano Erri de Luca, un best-seller mundial, a su vez un gran escalador… que frecuentemente lo practica sin cuerda.

‘The Last Expedition’ 
Indaga en la desaparición en el Kangchenjunga de Wanda Rutkiewicz, en 1992. Muchos la consideran la mejor alpinista de la historia. Premiada como la Mejor Película de Alpinismo en el Mendi Film, y entre otros muchos reconocimientos internacionales como Mejor Documental en los principales Premios del Cine en Polonia, está dirigida por la cineasta polaca Eliza Kubarska, una de las referencias imprescindibles del cine de montaña.

‘Of a Lifetime’ 
Se llevó el Premio a la Mejor Fotografía en el Mendi Film. Una bella, estética y trepidante aventura de esquí y alpinismo en la Antártida, protagonizada por los hermanos mega-estrellas de la nieve Xavier y Victor de le Rue, y la emergente hija del primero, Mila.

‘Always Alive’ 
Presenta a la corredora por montaña Hilary Gerardi en el intento de batir el récord a pie de la subida y bajada al Mont Blanc desde Chamonix, reflejando, a su vez, la preocupación del impacto del cambio climático sobre los glaciares.

‘Red Rock Revolution’ 
Es un exquisito cortometraje que narra el descubrimiento en los 70 de Red Rock Canyon como destino de escalada, a cargo del matrimonio Urioste.

Hay viajes que terminan y hay viajes que solo cambian de sitio: se te meten dentro y ya no se van.

Diez días.
Miles de curvas.
Cinco mil metros de altura y la sensación de estar tocando algo más grande que nosotros.
Hemos subido a Komic, donde la carretera se acaba y empieza el cielo.

Hemos cruzado el Spity con el río abajo y los precipicios al lado, aprendiendo a perderle el miedo al vacío.

Y sobre todo hemos visto lo que pasa cuando un grupo de desconocidos arranca junto el primer día y el último ya no puede despedirse sin abrazarse.

Hoy las Royal Enfield descansan. El polvo del Himalaya sigue en las botas y no pensamos limpiarlo todavía.

Gracias a cada rider,Adolfo, Javier, Miguel, Néstor, Joaquín, Ángel, Carlos, Manjay y Mala que han formado parte …  por ponerle alma a esta ruta. Gracias a los guías, a las montañas y a las carreteras imposibles que nos dejaron pasar.

Esto no es un adiós. Es un "hasta la próxima".

caption:
There's a lot to celebrate at Sydney Contemporary's 10th edition.

This year, the Works on Paper sector brings together some of Australia's most influential print studios, collectives and organisations, many marking significant milestones of their own.

From the 60th anniversary of the Print Council of Australia and the 45th anniversary of Australian Print Workshop, to 35 years of Open Bite Printmakers and over four decades of artist-led activity at UPSPACE Gallery+Studios/Ultimo Project, the sector highlights the rich history and enduring relevance of paper-based practice in Australia.

Visitors can also celebrate 25 years of Baldessin Studio, with the launch of a new publication at the Fair, alongside presentations from Sydney Printmakers and a community that has championed printmaking, editions, artist books and works on paper for generations.

One of the most accessible entry points for new collectors and a perennial favourite for seasoned buyers, Works on Paper remains a place of discovery, experimentation and exceptional collecting opportunities.

Here's to the past, present and future of print.

Sydney Contemporary returns to Carriageworks from 3–6 September 2026. Tickets are on sale now through the link in bio.

Sydney Contemporary has always been shaped as much by its home city as by the global art world it brings together. This year, a strong cohort of forty Sydney-based galleries underscores that relationship, anchoring the Fair in the city’s own creative ecology while pushing its edges outward.

From storied spaces to experimental rooms, these galleries reflect the breadth of practice that defines Sydney right now: established voices shown alongside newer, more restless programs.

What emerges is less a “local section” than a portrait of a scene in motion, one that continues to test scale, ambition and form, and that sits firmly within the wider conversation Sydney Contemporary stages each year.

Two painters that are fifty years apart yet remarkably in sync are presented by Jacob Hoerner Galleries at Sydney Contemporary.

The presentation brings together the vibrant abstract paintings of Brett Weir and pioneering perspex works by Andrew Sibley.

Weir's layered aluminium surfaces shimmer with colour and movement, while Sibley's experimental works from the 1970s demonstrate why great art never feels tied to a single moment in time.

A chance to experience two artists pushing the boundaries of painting from different generations, brought together in one compelling presentation.

See it at Sydney Contemporary from 3–6 September 2026 at Carriageworks, Sydney. First Release tickets are on sale now. Save up to 35% before 10 July (link in bio).

Known for her lavish photographic tableaux, Alexia Sinclair creates richly imagined worlds where history, fashion and fantasy collide.

As we mark the 50th anniversary of NAIDOC Week, Sydney Contemporary proudly acknowledges and celebrates the strength and resilience of First Nations peoples.

This year's theme, “50 Years Of Deadly' celebrates a half-century of the NAIDOC movement, honouring Elders, Activists and communities who have shaped Indigenous voices and resilience.

We reflect on Juanita McLaughlan’s work Mandaymanday / String of Stars, winner of the 2025 MA Art Prize. Working across materials and concepts with an experimental and rigorous approach, McLauchlan uses her cultural foundation as both a guiding framework and a powerful generative force.

Sydney Contemporary, presented in partnership with MA Financial Group, returns to Carriageworks from 3-6 September

Mandaymanday / String of Stars, 2025 Presented by Cassandra Bird

We caught up with designer Alix Higgins on his top picks of Sydney.

Higgins’ practice is shaped by emotion, digital nostalgia, and a unique translation of poetry into wearable fabric armour.

In our conversation, he speaks about fashion as an intuitive form of storytelling, the constant tension between internet culture and physical wearability, and how he relies on his close-knit community of creative muses to keep his distinct, whimsical voice entirely untouched.

Every year, we offer an emerging artist the opportunity to take part by creating the Festival artwork, through which they can reach a wider audience while emphasising the vital role artists play in storytelling.

This year, Balinese painter Aris Sarmanta is the creative mind behind the official artwork, inspired by the theme Samarasā: Awareness. Empathy. Action.

We spoke with the exciting talent, whose work is rooted in the Batuan painting tradition, to explore the vision and creative process behind his work, as well as his reflections on the festival’s theme and Ubud.

Check out our website to read the full interview (or link in bio).

—

Setiap tahun, kami mengundang seorang seniman muda untuk menciptakan karya seni Festival, sekaligus membuka peluang untuk menjangkau audiens yang lebih luas dan menyoroti peran penting seniman dalam bercerita.

Tahun ini, pelukis Bali Aris Sarmanta menciptakan karya resmi Festival yang terinspirasi dari tema Samarasā: Awareness. Empathy. Action.

Kami berbincang dengan Aris, yang karyanya berakar pada tradisi lukisan Batuan, untuk menggali visi dan proses kreatif di balik karyanya, serta refleksinya terhadap tema festival dan Ubud.

＜PUSHIM・韻シストBAND＞出演決定！

＜PUSHIM＞ @shinoyama_pushim
1995年に地元大阪で活動を開始。
その歌声を聞くと、誰もが“Feel The Soul (=魂を感じる)”“Strong Voice!(=力強い声)”“One &Only(=誰にも真似できない)”と形容されるプレミアム・シンガー。 “クイーン・オブ・レゲエ”として、今やジャパニーズ・レゲエ・シーンNo.1シンガーの座を確固たるものにしたと同時に、日本の音楽シーンの中でも圧倒的な歌唱 力を誇るシンガーとして高い評価を受け続けている。
2015年には自身のレーベル“Groovillage”を設立させるなど、更に活動の幅を拡げている。
2019年3月にはオリジナルアルバムとしては10枚目となる「immature」をリリース。
Zepp5箇所全10公演のPUSHIM 20th ANNIVERSARY LIVE TOUR”immature”や大阪JOULEと渋谷VISIONで行われたTHE MIDNIGHT PARTYも超満員で終える。
2021年には Mini Album 『深呼吸』をリリース。リリースに伴い、PUSHIM LIVE TOUR 2021 ”深呼吸”と題した東名阪Zeppツアーを開催し大成功を収めた。2年後の2023年にはMEDZ MUSIC協力の元、アルバム「Dialogue」をリリース。今年2024年はデビューから25周年のアニバーサリーイヤーを迎え、GrooPeePartyと題し自身のファンサイトをリニューアル。その唯一無二の歌唱力にエンパワーメントのメッセージを乗せ、円熟味を増しつつも「REBEL」の精神を貫くその姿は多くの人々の心を掴み、勇気付け続けている。

＜韻シストBAND＞ @in_sistagram
生々しく独創的でグルーヴィーなサウンドと極上のライブパフォーマンスが圧倒的な評価を受け続ける、大阪をベースに活動するファンキーグルーヴマスターと称される唯一無二のヒップホップバンド。数度のメンバー・チェンジを経て、MC（サッコン)、Gtr. (TAKU)、Bass (Shyoudog)、Drs.(TAROW-ONE)からなる現メンバーとなる。1998年の結成当初から大阪を拠点として活動し、日本におけるヒップホップ・バンドのパイオニア的存在として、またミュージシャンズ・ミュージシャンとして高い評価を受け続けている。

Cosas importantes que muchos nos estáis preguntando, sobre La Invernal que es distinto al festival de verano. 

Aquí te aclaramos los puntos principales:
-Motorbeach no es una concentración motera. Motorbeach es Motorbeach. 

- Los niños podrán circular en moto libremente por todo el recinto del festival (menores de 12 años) 

🏍️ Motos con matrícula, igual que el resto de vehículos. Sin matrícula no se accede al recinto. Solo habrá invitaciones especiales para ciertas customizaciones.

🚫 Dentro del recinto no hay enduro ni motocross. Las motos no registradas se quedan fuera, en el parking de día, como pasa en cualquier evento de motos. 

🏕️ Solo acceden las motos de la zona de acampada, las invitadas, las del Bike show y sin movilidad por el recinto: entrar y salir de la zona, nada más.

🔒 Recinto vallado, con control de accesos y seguridad privada durante todo el evento. Fuera del recinto, cada uno es responsable de lo que haga.

⛺ Acampada y parking se colocarán de uno en uno. La idea es descansar bien, no montar un camping- party. Quien lo prefiera tiene bastantes hoteles en la zona.

👥 Aforo máximo: 3.500 personas.

La idea es hacer el Motorbeach de siempre, sin dejar rienda suelta dentro del recinto, que es responsabilidad nuestra. Iremos explicando el resto de detalles poco a poco por aquí. ¡Gracias por el interés! 🤘

2022年 カヴァーアルバム『COVER JUNGLE1』『COVER JUNGLE2』をリリース。セルフカヴァーの収録曲「これさえあれば」は、Ｔ字路sが劇伴を手掛けた映画 『メタモルフォーゼの縁側』で主演の芦田愛菜と宮本信子が主題歌として 歌唱し話題に。同アルバムを引っ提げて行った全国ツアーはソールドアウトが続出、同年開催されたフジロックフェスティバル等数々のイベントにも出演し各地で好評を得る。
2023年は、初のベストアルバム『THE BEST OF T字路s』、The Street Slidersのトリビュート作品、NHKラジオ深夜便のテーマ、NHKみんなのうた、日本テレビ ドラマ「だが、情熱はある」の劇伴と精力的にリリース。 2025年4月 ソニーミュージック‧エピックレコードジャパンからメジャーデビュー。 二人が織りなす音楽はブルースやフォーク、ロックンロールを飲み込みつつ、ジャンルの壁を超えるものであり、 人生における激情や悲喜交交を人間臭く表現した楽曲たちがファンの心を鷲掴みにしている。

caption:
ALMERÍA SE RECORRE. Y SE DISFRUTA CURVA A CURVA. 🏍️☀️

Los días 26 y 27 de febrero, Sun To Sun Almería nos lleva a descubrir una provincia donde en pocos kilómetros puedes pasar del paisaje árido del desierto a una auténtica carretera de montaña.

Por un lado, la N-340a, puerta de entrada al Desierto de Tabernas: ramblas, cárcavas, casi 3.000 horas de sol al año y algunos de los paisajes cinematográficos más reconocibles de Almería. Aquí se han rodado cientos de producciones y todavía permanecen varios de aquellos escenarios del western.

Y después, rumbo a la Sierra de los Filabres y al Alto de Velefique: aproximadamente 13 km de subida, un desnivel cercano a los 950 metros, una pendiente media del 7,2 % y cima a 1.789 metros. 

Desierto, cine, montaña y carreteras para disfrutar conduciendo.

Eso es Almería.

SUN TO SUN ALMERÍA 📅 26–27 de febrero,  gasolina, paisaje y carretera.

caption:
This is how we make festivals transformational…

We clear our minds from the chaos we’re ready to leave behind.
We set an intention for the weekend.
We connect authentically with new and familiar faces.

We massage tension out of our bodies,
and soften our hearts from self-judgment.
We stomp out what’s been holding us back,
and we let our inner child run free.

Because transformation at festivals is subtle.
It’s not always a peak psychedelic moment…
often it’s a shift of energy.
From stress into groundedness.
From chaos into presence.
From overthinking into embodiment.

It’s taking off the masks we wear in everyday life
and arriving as our most authentic selves.

People left this workshop lighter,
some cried what they’d been holding for months,
some finally arrived after a stressful week,
some walked out intentional and ready to doof with purpose.

These subtle shifts are what make a festival transformational.

If you haven’t integrated yet, here are your prompts:

✨ What moments would you re-live? How did you feel in these moments? 
✨ Did any challenges come up? If so, how did you cope with them? Did you learn anything about yourself from them?
✨ What feeling/pattern/mindset do you want to take with you back into everyday life?

caption:
Tjakura Tjukurpa: painted together by mother and daughter, Josephine Mick and Inawantji (Ina) Scales Alyana

Josephine Mick is an artist from the APY Lands (Anangu Pitjantjatjara Yankunytjatjara) in the far north-west of South Australia. As a Ngangkari (traditional healer) and senior cultural leader, Josephine carries responsibility for these stories and the laws they embody, bringing them to life through her artwork, ceremonies, and songs.

"This painting forms part of the Tjukurpa of Wati Tjakura, the edible skink ancestor. In this story, the Warnmala (army) of Wati Wanampi (snake men) from Kata Tjuta and Malara go to battle against Wati Tjakura with spears.

This begins at the base of Uluru that interconnects with the Tjukurpa of Aralya.

In this painting, my daughter and I painted our Tjukurpa. After the rain the bush flowers bloom for the Tjakura to eat. The rock formations, waterhole, the cave and the sand dunes tell our Tjukurpa." 

— Josephine Mick

TOKYO No.1 SOUL SETのヴォーカル、ギター、サウンド・プロダクションを担当し、独自のメロディとカラーを持つヴォーカルは各方面で定評があり、さまざまなアーティストの作品に参加する「渡辺俊美」。

そして、GO OUT CAMPのステージには欠かせない存在となり、会場を一体にするハッピーな空気感でお馴染みの双子ラップユニット「上鈴木兄弟」の2組が出演決定しました！

【渡辺俊美】 @toshimi_watanabe

1966年12月6日　福島県川内村生まれ 富岡町育ち
1990年当初に結成されたTOKYO No.1 SOUL SETのギター、ヴォーカル、サウンド・プロダクション担当。
2010年には同じ福島県出身の山口隆・箭内道彦・松田晋二の4名で猪苗代湖ズを結成。
2011年3月に録音した「I love you & I need you ふくしま」で第62回NHK紅白歌合戦に出場。
当時高校生だった息子に3年間にわたって作り続けた弁当が話題となり、エッセイ『461個の弁当は、親父と息子の男の約束。』として2014年にマガジンハウスより出版、ベストセラーに。
漫画化およびNHKでテレビドラマ化された後に、2020年には「461個のおべんとう」のタイトルで映画化。兼重淳がメガホンを取り、父親役を井ノ原快彦・息子役を「なにわ男子」の道枝駿佑が好演。劇中音楽も担当。
2022年からは帽子を軸としたハットブランド「HEADS」を手掛け、全国各地でPOP UP SHOPを展開中。

【上鈴木兄弟】 
@kamisuzuki @hakushu

上鈴木タカヒロ(兄)、上鈴木伯周(弟)の双子のラッパー。
2024までラップグループP.O.P(ピーオーピー)を率いて活動。
映画『SR サイタマノラッパー』シリーズ全編においてラップ監修・指導を担当。また、NHK Eテレ「ムジカ・ピッコリーノ」「シャキーン!」、おはスタ内アニメ「Bラッパーズストリート」、日本テレビ系ドラマ「ネメシス」、ポケモンKids TV「ポケライム」シリーズなど、テレビやCM、他アーティストへの楽曲提供・ラップ監修を務め、幅広い年代にラップを届けている。
ライブで観客にビールを配りまくるスタイルが興じて、地元宇都宮のブルワリーとコラボでオリジナルビールをこれまでに14回リリース。右手にビール、左手にドリームを掲げ、日々ビール外交に勤しんでいる。
キーワードは「たのしいことばかりありますように」

Once again having The Cordoaria Nacional as the main venue of ARCOlisboa, this year the fair celebrates the important milestone of 10 years in Portugal. The fair, directed by @mlopezambrana, is organized into different curatorial sections: the General Programme, which brings together national and international galleries, and the Opening Lisboa section, curated by Sofía Lanusse and Diogo Pinto and dedicated to promoting new artistic languages and research. This edition also includes a special project led by curator Cosmin Costinas, which will explore traditional knowledge within the context of contemporary artistic creation.

𝗔𝘁 𝗟𝗗𝗪‘𝟮𝟲
The LDW Lounge of ARCOlisboa 2026, conceived by architect, artist, and designer Joana Astolfi, unfolds as a 100 m² living room embedded within the fair’s main space. Astolfi brings together a selection of designers participating in Lisbon Design Week, inviting them to contribute to the project: the space is conceived as an inhabited environment, an open welcoming setting where visitors, gallerists and participants are encouraged to pause, meet and converse.
The lounge will also host both the ARCOlisboa information desk and key information related to Lisbon Design Week, positioning it as a central hub for orientation and exchange.

Join stoicism expert Brigid Delaney, author of The Seeker and the Sage, for lessons and practices to follow the path to stoicism while meeting change with readiness and acceptance. This is a practical guide by Brigid Delaney. Change is the only constant, and Stoicism offers a powerful framework to help you meet it with courage and clarity. This workshop is for anyone navigating transitions: career shifts, leadership roles, burnout, or personal upheaval. 

Delaney draws on ancient texts and contemporary psychology to show how Stoic thinking can help you reframe uncertainty, build inner steadiness, and act wisely under pressure. Through writing prompts and group exercises you will leave with a clear action plan and a Stoic toolkit to manage change, not just survive it.

The price includes a coffee and tea break.

Bergabunglah bersama pakar stoisisme Brigid Delaney, penulis The Seeker and the Sage, untuk pelajaran dan praktik guna mengikuti jalan stoisisme sambil menghadapi perubahan dengan kesiapan dan penerimaan. Ini adalah panduan praktis dari Brigid Delaney. Perubahan adalah satu-satunya hal yang konstan, dan Stoisisme menawarkan kerangka kerja yang kuat untuk membantu Anda menghadapinya dengan keberanian dan kejernihan. Lokakarya ini ditujukan bagi siapa saja yang sedang menjalani masa transisi: pergantian karier, peran kepemimpinan, burnout, atau gejolak pribadi. 

Delaney memadukan teks-teks kuno dan psikologi kontemporer untuk menunjukkan bagaimana pemikiran Stoik dapat membantu Anda memaknai ulang ketidakpastian, membangun kestabilan batin, dan bertindak bijaksana di bawah tekanan. Melalui latihan menulis dan kegiatan kelompok, Anda akan pulang dengan rencana tindakan yang jelas dan perangkat Stoik untuk mengelola perubahan, bukan sekadar bertahan menghadapinya.

Harga sudah termasuk kopi dan istirahat minum teh.

Artist spotlight- Sara Gonzalez

Studio # 26

Sara Gonzalez is a Brisbane based ceramicist working primarily with wood-fired processes, firing with Venessa Skye at Middle Pocket Pottery. 

Her pieces, ranging from tableware to sculptural vessels, are fired for over 100 hours, capturing natural ash deposits and rich surface variation. 

Each work reflects a deep connection to material, place and the unpredictability of atmospheric firing.

Sara will be joining Venessa @middlepocketpottery at her studio for the 2026 Mud Trail.

We have your Saturday night sorted. Head on down to the Byron Twilight Market, wander around the stalls, grab some local food, then settle in for live and free music from acclaimed Northern Rivers folk rock artist Cheynne Murphy.

Originally from Nowra on the NSW South Coast, Cheynne found his voice with “three chords and the truth” before signing a worldwide songwriting deal with BMG. Since then, he has built a reputation for big, warm, sprawling folk rock that blends pop, alternative country and unmistakably Australian storytelling. He has shared stages at Bluesfest with artists such as Jack Johnson and Ben Harper, earned national radio airplay and songwriting awards, and been praised as a rare songwriting talent.

Performing as a duo alongside long time collaborator and respected local musician Mark Heazlett on harmonies and guitar, Cheynne will also be launching his new single Country Singer, out on streaming the same day.

Classic Aussie folk rock, soulful stories, soaring acoustic guitars and melodies made for a summer night in Byron.

Joining us with fresh stories after riding 5762kms Scandinavia to Morocco (!), Annie is a marine scientist, explorer, Guinness world record holder (MTB), cold water sailor, CEO, and environmental activist. Annie combines ‘Passion and Purpose’, using her bike to tell stories, fundraise, and raise awareness of community and environmental issues. 

She believes in the power of community, the importance of intergenerational planning, and activation of individuals to become custodians of land and sea. Her adventure challenges have raised attention & money, for causes including land replanting, native revegetation, waterways management and shed light on the world’s largest offshore seismic survey for oil in Australian waters, which has since been cancelled due to community pressure. 

Whether you’re a land manager, MTBer, advocate, trails steward or explorer. we know everyone with be inspired to hear how Annie has turned #WildIdeas into wildly successful actions and a more sustainable world.

✨ The Temple Grant Program is evolving ✨

We’re excited to share an update designed to better support Temple artists and strengthen this meaningful tradition in Black Rock City.

Starting with the 2027 Temple, the timeline is shifting earlier, giving the selected artist ~4 extra months to dream, design, and plan this ambitious project.

🗓️ Applications open April 30, 2026
⏳ Deadline: June 4, 2026 at 5pm PDT

The Temple is one of the most profound and transformative spaces in Black Rock City — a place for reflection, healing, and remembrance. With the scale and responsibility this work carries, we’re introducing a longer, multi-year timeline to better support artists from early concept through completion.

Interested in applying? Join us for a virtual Q&A with the Art Department and key Temple stakeholders:

In February Argentina’s official Regional Event @fuegoaustral celebrated its 10th edition with a gathering inspired by the theme “Olympic Fires.” Camps, art, activations, and experiences intimate and bold reminded participants that a city is not built by structures alone, but through presence, Gifting, and Participation.

The event has grown into a vibrant community deeply committed to the 10 Principles and to building something meaningful together, not only during the once-a-year event, but throughout the year. Together they create smaller events, workshops, and community participation at @lasedefa, Fuego Austral's maker space in Buenos Aires.

A decade of regional events for Fuego Austral is more than a milestone. It is the vivid story of a community that keeps growing, learning, showing up for one another, and welcoming Burners from all around the world.

With no walls to hold us back and no borders to hold us up, the first names for Mucho Flow 2026 have been announced!

Among the artists are My New Band Believe, a new project by Cameron Picton (ex- black midi); the no-man’s-land folklore of Dagmar Zuniga; the dark electronic sounds of Kavari; the super-melodic hip hop of Liim; the electric punk of Mandy, Indiana; the songbook of Jana Horn; and the drum and bass of gyrofield.

From October 29 to 31, the festival will take over downtown Guimarães with concerts, live, dj sets and talks. 

Together, we’re creating a dance floor to occupy, disrupt, regenerate, and share. More news coming soon!

Mucho Flow is organized by Revolve, in co-production with Oficina, with funding from the Municipality of Guimarães, DG Artes and TPNP.

Sneak peek! The 2025 MOOP Map will be revealed first at the Camp Symposium, on Saturday, March 14, before it’s released to the wider community. Yes, YOU are invited. 

Every year, the MOOP Map tells the story of how Black Rock City cleaned up after itself — the good, the bad, and the dusty (but mostly the good!). It reflects the Leave No Trace efforts of BRC citizens and what the Playa Restoration team discovered and removed during their post-event sweep to return the playa to its pristine condition.

MOOP stands for Matter Out Of Place — anything left behind in the Black Rock Desert that’s not dust.

Pitch 2026 → A note of gratitude

The grounds welcomed us back greener than ever. New growth across the landscape, familiar corners returning to life. The symbolism wasn’t lost on us; the regrowth of the festival felt present everywhere you looked.

Across four indulgent days together, we witnessed something that cannot be programmed. A crowd deeply connected to the music, attentive and present both on the dancefloor and beyond. It was a reminder of what Pitch is all about: community, togetherness, and the kind of joy that only really exists when it’s shared.

This year saw all three stages reimagined with new designs, creating some of the most immersive dancefloor environments in Pitch’s history. Watching them come alive across the weekend was something special.

The addition of The Rock Pool is a testament to how the Pitch experience continues to evolve. It was beautiful to see so many of you enjoying our new swimming station. By Monday morning it was clear a new tradition had already begun.

Pitch will always hold space for the weird and the wonderful. That spirit lived not only in the creativity of your dress-ups, but also in the quiet and curious presence of Mother Goblin, watching over our ninth gathering.

None of this happens without collaboration.

To the artists, performers and creatives who shared their work, thank you for the energy you brought to the plains. 

To the crew, staff, volunteers, suppliers, contractors and emergency services, your work behind the scenes allows everything on the surface to unfold.

To the Djab Wurrung & Eastern Maar Peoples, respected elders, and the communities of Mafeking, Moyston, Pomonal, Willaura and Ararat, thank you for welcoming us back onto Country.

And finally, to the People of Pitch, your creativity and openness give this festival its spirit. The way you showed up for each other with kindness and generosity did not go unnoticed.

As we prepare to enter our tenth year, we’re reminded how far this community has come. Thank you for growing alongside us. We can't wait to celebrate a decade of dancing with you in 2027.

Until then, with love,
The Pitch Team

A crazy combination: Frenchman Simo Cell, a rhythmic master of the dancefloor, with Colombian producer and TraTraTrax label-boss Verraco, a ultra-heavy bass with hot beats crafter of bangers. We can’t predict exactly how this duo will play out in a back-to-back set, but we do know there’ll be rhythmic fireworks, geographical possibilities, low-end frequencies, decays, and arpeggiated chords for every taste. We suggest you keep your long-term memory light, you’ll want to remember this slice of the party.

Passamos a vida a estilizar o rock e o punk, mas esquecemo-nos frequentemente da sua evolução; regressamos vezes demais a lugares suaves por aversão a riscos. Tudo isto define em oposição aquilo que bbb hairdryer é e faz: o coletivo encabeçado por Elisabete Guerra é bem rodeado, inspira-se no pico das guitarras para criar uma fórmula de verve, sangue e distorção em que todos os controladores estão no máximos: as guitarras rasgam-se em melodias, a bateria corre atrás delas em catadupa e volume global de tudo com as vozes, bem gritadas, somadas leva os ouvidos a colapsar, a própria gravação a clipar. A viagem é sempre alucinante, o som acutilante, e as memórias podem não ficar. Mas há traumas que o corpo não esquece, e nem sempre são maus.

●

Too often we have seen rockers taking the safest road to marketability and witnessing the decline of ethos in sound – this is exactly the way to not describe bbb hairdryer. Their approach to punk rock picks up on the most extreme of punk production and adds more abrasiveness, more decibels, and ton more fury to the mix. The result, recently released on our Revolve label, is a guitar oriented explosion of volumetric sound that doubles down on distortion, demanding the vocals to be always on scream mode and the drums and bass to chase them frantically. Their gigs are often hallucinating, their sound is always piercing in the ears, and the memories become frail. The good part is some traumas remain in the body, and not all of them are bad.

I’m still recovering from the 20th Year celebration of Byron Latin Fiesta but I wanted to take a moment to send out a proper THANK YOU! 

Some of you have messaged to say how much you enjoyed the whole festival. The vibe, the atmosphere and the amazing energy! Thank you to those who have taken that time out, to msg me in private, I really appreciate it. 

This year did feel pretty EPIC! The whole 20 year thing… and yes as many have said it did seem bigger & better than ever. That is a testament to so much! Yes, I work my butt off all year to make the event what it is, I pour my heart & soul in to it but it is also made extra special by all the fabulous people that are involved plus the beautiful guests who attend & then there is the unmistakable Byron vibes! 

There were a few hiccups, particularly with the venue’s Sound and Air-Con (new sound techs & venue staff… ahhhh!). We know this affected some of you and caused us unexpected stress. We apologise for the inconvenience — unfortunately, these issues were beyond our control.

A big thank you to all the ARTISTS – Instructors, Performers, DJs, and the Band. You are all hand-picked not only because you’re talented & awesome, but because you bring the right energy to this event. I choose each of you because you’re a pleasure to work with - respectful, and ego-free. After 25+ years in the industry, I’ve learned just how important that truly is.

Thanks to our MCS - Jean Luc & Nicholas. Our PHOTOGRAPHERS - Bob & Hielrick. Our SUPPORTERS, our VOLUNTEERS & our dedicated CREW! In addition, the DANCE SCHOOLS and PROMOTERS who helped spread the word in lead-up & who attended to participate & enjoy!

We did it TOGETHER and I am truly grateful. 

Are we doing it again next year? I think so… the SAVE THE DATE is already out there… but I can only do it with YOUR HELP. 

With love and gratitude, Sky Blue (Byron Latin Fiesta festival Director).

At @muchoflowfestival, London-based producer and vocalist @laurenduffus spoke about learning to embrace solitude in her creative process. She told us being alone allows her to take risks without feeling like she’s performing for others, and that’s when the work feels most authentic.

We also talked about collaboration, how studio environments can feel restrictive, and her growing interest in scoring and working with archival visuals tied to her father’s history.

Duffus’ music drifts between electronica, R&B, and ambient soundscapes, marked by emotional depth and atmospheric precision. Her latest EP, Can’s Gone Warm, folds introspection into genre-blurring compositions that explore loneliness, movement, and release.

Thanks Lauren!

Full 180 Meets coming soon on our YouTube channel.

Ahead of their show at @muchoflowfestival, Jack Barnett of @thesenewpuritans gave us a great insight into creative work: allow outsiders to contaminate the ideas that you’ve set for a project, even when you really want to keep that idea intact. 

He also told us how the overall sound for Crooked Wing and other records came to be, their collaborations with Elisa Rodrigues and Caroline Polachek, and much more.

Formed in Southend-on-Sea by twins Jack and George Barnett, These New Puritans fuse post-punk, classical, electronic, and experimental textures into an uncompromising art-rock vision. Their albums push the limits of pop form, marked by meticulous production and an ever-shifting sense of scale and emotion.

Thanks Jack!

Full 180 Meets coming soon on our Youtube channel.

At @muchoflowfestival, @infinityknives and @brianennals told us how finishing their latest record “A City Drowned in God’s Black Tears”, was a process that took a big toll on them. But if it was so hard, why do it? They gave us a straight answer: it’s still much better than having a normal job. 

Brian also told us about how tapping into existential stress and anger to write and rap can be draining, but that it also becomes a release valve for those emotions.

Infinity Knives & Brian Ennals are a Baltimore-based duo whose music fuses experimental hip-hop with a cinematic and political edge. Their songs bring together Infinity Knives’ rich, unpredictable production and Brian Ennals’ sharp, furious lyricism. Together, they confront issues of race, class, and power, in an artful yet uncompromising way.

Thanks guys!

Full 180 Meets coming soon on our Youtube channel.

At @muchoflowfestival, @bodymeatco told us how he learned to trust his own instincts again. That when he feels distant from what he’s creating, listeners usually do too.

We also talked about his work connecting music and game design, his approach to visual storytelling, and how interactivity can shape sound and emotion.

Body Meat is the project of Chris Taylor, a producer and vocalist whose music folds experimental pop, club rhythms, and hyper-detailed sound design into something tactile and unpredictable.

Thanks Chris!

Full 180 Meets coming soon on our YouTube channel.

Há algo de verdadeiramente topográfico nos sets de Minna-no-Kimochi, que tem uma relação imediata e direta com o facto de serem oriundos de Tóquio. Constantes no ritmo, é no andamento acelerado que nos levam a ver todas as cores do arco-íris de neon que é a capital nipónica. Em termos menos crípticos, isto quer dizer que há uma verborreia de sintetizadores, brilhantes e nada secos, com que elevam batidas e controlam batimentos cardíacos; trabalham em torrente de camadas, em melodias de êxtase e andamentos acelerados, mas com uma plasticidade narrativa que lhes permite um sob e desce emocional. Não é linear, como nenhum set tem de ser, mas acaba sempre em alegrias máximas.

●

There’s something truly topographic about Minna-no-kimochi’s sets, directly tied to the fact that they hail from Tokyo. Constant in rhythm, their accelerated pace makes us see all the neon rainbow colours of Japan’s capital. In less cryptic terms: a torrent of synths, shiny and never and drenched in modulations, lifting beats to regulate heart rates; torrents of layers, ecstatic melodies, and racing tempos, with a narrative plasticity that allows emotional rises and falls. A Minna-no-Kimochi set is non-linear, but always abides to a golden rule: maximum color yields maximum joy.

Num mundo de pens, de stream, de consumo rápido, e de intangíveis, Leila Beesley, conhecida pelo seu nome de mixer Chinese Daughter, existe em prática nos antípodas destas ideias. Digger nata, Beesley atua única e exclusivamente com vinil, tirando de cada rodela e a cada rotação o mais puro som de batidas quebradas e graves profundos de jungle e hardcore clássico. Podem iniciar as preparações a ouvir os seus sets na Rinse ou na Balamii, contextos justamente dedicados àquilo que mais nos apraz numa pista de dança: alucinações rítmicas e levitações induzidas pelos baixos intensos.

●

In a world of pen drives, streams, fast consumption, and intangibles, Leslie Beesley — better known by her DJ name Chinese Daughter — stands at the very opposite side of the digital playing field. Digger worthy of the name, Beesley plays exclusively on vinyl, pulling from every record and every rotation the purest sound of broken beats and the deep basslines of jungle and classic hardcore. You can start preparing by listening to her sets on Rinse or Balamii, both rightly dedicated to what we most love on a dancefloor: rhythmic hallucinations and bass-induced levitations.Pack lightly, ‘cause jungle is massive.

Uma combinação de loucos: o francês Simo Cell, mestre rítmico do dancefloor, com o colombiano Verraco, fundador da TraTraTrax e produtor de sons super graves com batidas quentes. Não sabemos bem prever como é que esta dupla se vai manifestar num back to back, mas sabemos que há-de haver expressões rítmicas possibilidades geográficas, baixos de frequências e decays e acordes arpejados para todos os gostos. Sugerimos que levem a vossa memória a longo-prazo ligeira, porque vão querer lembrar-se deste pedaço de festa.

●

A crazy combination: Frenchman Simo Cell, a rhythmic master of the dancefloor, with Colombian producer and TraTraTrax label-boss Verraco, a ultra-heavy bass with hot beats crafter of bangers. We can’t predict exactly how this duo will play out in a back-to-back set, but we do know there’ll be rhythmic fireworks, geographical possibilities, low-end frequencies, decays, and arpeggiated chords for every taste. We suggest you keep your long-term memory light, you’ll want to remember this slice of the party.

Com a lição house bem estudada, Sassy 009 representa o melhor da escola escandinava da pop: melodias orelhudas, das que se instalam pelos tímpanos, ocupam os recantos encefálicos e permanecem na cavidade toráxica. Através de elementos da eletrónica, com uma aplicação exemplar dos ambientes da eletrónica, Sunniva Lindgård cria canções que não deixam ninguém indiferente, ao ponto de ter captado atenções bem além da sua península e de se firmar como permanente promessa do futuro da pop. Tudo a concretizar no Mucho Flow. Esta podem pôr já nas vossas playlists, que é dada.

●

With house and electronic music lessons well studied, Sassy 009 represents the best of the Scandinavian school of pop: catchy melodies turned into earworms, brain-lodging harmonic ideas, chest resonating production wits. Through electronic elements and masterful use of atmospheric textures, Sunniva Lindgård creates songs that move even the coldest stone and capture attention far beyond geographical limitations. Already a staple of the pop to be scene, Sassy 009 is not a promise, because she already delivered. We are just getting it now. You can already add her to your playlists, it’s a given.

Movendo-se no universo pop com uma desenvoltura impar, Lauren Duffus resgata um século de cancioneiros para elaborar uma versão hiperbólica de tudo o pode ser a versão contemporânea das expressões mainstream. O resultado bebe tanto à alegria do rnb como ao dramatismo do trip hop, junta o corpo ao garage e cria espaço com baladas, guiando os movimentos e as emoções com uma voz pejada de efeitos e intenções. É um movimento de décadas a culminar nas mais emocionantes peças de hoje, prestes a agitar o famoso turbilhão de emoções de Guimarães.

●

Moving within the pop universe with unmatched ease, Lauren Duffus draws on a century of songwriting to craft a hyperbolic version of what contemporary mainstream expression can be. The result drinks as much from the joy of R&B as from the drama of trip hop, grounds itself in garage, and creates space with ballads, guiding movement and emotion with a voice layered with effects and intention. Decades of evolution culminate in today’s most exciting pieces, ready to stir up the famous whirlwind of emotions in Guimarães.

There’s a slightly less sexy side to an arts festival — and it’s a battle we’re facing right now.

When we started @miamimarketta, and later SURFACE Festival, the vision was bigger than events and murals.

We wanted to help turn Miami into an arts district.

Because culture creates economy.

Artists make places interesting.
Interesting places attract people.
People bring cafés, bars, restaurants, residents, investment and development.

And then comes the tricky part…

How do we make sure development doesn’t erase the culture that made the area desirable in the first place?

As Miami changes, we’re losing walls — and with them, artworks that have become part of the identity of this neighbourhood.

So we think there needs to be a really simple conversation with developers:

If you’re knocking down a wall with art on it, replace the art.

Not necessarily the same artwork. Not necessarily the same artist. But make space for art in what comes next.

Development and culture don’t have to compete. In fact, the best precincts in the world prove they’re stronger when they grow together.

We’re at the point where we need to get this conversation in front of the people shaping the next version of Miami.

Know a developer working on the Gold Coast? Tag them below. 👇

And a shout out to @srama_goldcoast for recognising the value of what’s been created here.

But also… hey, let’s talk. 👀

If anyone knows the developer that bought the corner site of Mountain View Miami where @_jackfran painted we want to talk to them.

Why do some amazing tattoo artists never get noticed?

It’s not always about talent.

In this industry, many artists create incredible work every day.
Great technique. Strong style. Years of dedication.

But sometimes the difference isn’t skill.

It’s exposure, resources, and opportunity.

That’s one of the reasons we started the InkPro Vanguard Program.

InkPro Vanguard is built to support tattoo artists who are serious about their craft and ready to grow.

Through the program we collaborate with artists on:

• Tattoo machine testing
• Real artist reviews
• Content creation
• Convention opportunities
• Long-term partnerships

This isn’t about sending products and asking for posts.

It’s about building a community of artists who push the craft forward together.

Artists across New Zealand and Australia are already part of the Vanguard community, and we’re always excited to connect with more.

If you’re a tattoo artist who’s passionate about what you do
—or you know someone whose work deserves to be seen—

Let’s talk.

A sneak peak of our 2026 Resident Advisor stage → Less than 200 Passes remain

Moving to a new location this year, designers @studio.raito  have deliberately shaped the space around the natural conditions of the Grampian Plains.

Featuring one of the site’s magnificent trees as its spatial and symbolic centre, its canopy offering natural shade during the day.

Complimented by a Funktion-One sound system, the space is defined by a series of towers referencing familiar elements from contemporary public space.

At night, the towers radiate light across their outer surfaces, with visual and lighting design developed in collaboration with visual artists @hugoyunus (Studio Raito) and @brendan.hardwood) in a hybrid setup.

This year’s design is one that needs to be lived and it’s dancefloor experienced to be understood. Only then will you fully comprehend why we’re coining it the most immersive Resident Advisor stage to date.

reWILD explores how we stay connected to our wildness in turbulent times. Mparntwe-based singer-songwriter and poet, Emma Trenorden, will be joined by band Anchor & Kite to create soundscapes of bass, drum and strings that are both grounding and uplifting. Emma's music is a healing balm that both soothes and enlivens the spirit.

Emma Trenorden is a Mparntwe-based poet and singer-songwriter. Born on the volcanic island of Rabaul, she now calls the red dirt and blue skies of Arrernte country home. She is an Arts Therapist with an interest in how we care for our wellbeing in a changing climate. In 2024 she released her debut EP, reWILD, alongside a debut book of poems, HIGH FIRE DANGER. The poems, written in response to the Black Summer Fires, and songs of reWILD are a way for Emma to contemplate ways to stay connected to our wildness in these turbulent times.

We invite all guests to gather at Pitch One on Saturday at 2:15pm for the Welcome to Country ceremony, a moment to acknowledge and pay respect to the Traditional Owners of the land we temporarily call home.

We recognise the Djab Wurrung and Eastern Maar Peoples as the Traditional Custodians of the land on which Pitch takes place.

Participating in the Welcome to Country is an opportunity to honour the enduring connection of the Djab Wurrung and Eastern Maar Peoples to Gariwerd (The Grampians), Moyston, and the surrounding landscapes, land that always was and always will be Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander land.

Heather & Martin – North Coast Casineros

Founders of North Coast Casineros, Heather and Martin love sharing their knowledge of Cuban dance. Since 2010, they have trained with Cuban maestro Eric Turro, immersing themselves in the rich traditions of Cuban social dance and performing at festivals and cultural events across Australia and New Zealand, including for the Cuban Ambassadors.

Based in the Northern Rivers, they teach Casino (Cuban Salsa), Son, Cha Cha Cha and Rueda de Casino, while fostering a love of Cuban music and dance through their classes and social dance nights in Lismore. Loyal supporters of the Byron Latin Fiesta, this talented duo are back in 2026!

Hey! It’s May here! I’m the Event Coordinator for the Flash Foxy Mini Fest happening in #thegunks October 2nd - 4th. @mostly_limbs asked if I could take over the Instagram for a few days thought “hmm, what to post?” So, I decided to show you my love for the Shawngunks, the land of smokey air.
.
.
One of my favorite climbing moments in the Gunks was climbing Bonnie’s Roof (5.9) with @litwinmenon, a multi pitch route in the Trapps at the Mohonk Preserve.  Bonnie’s has a little of everything… cracks to a roof to more cracks to a wild traverse, all within 5.7-5.9, a very old school grade. I was feeling confident in my climbing ability at the time to try following the route, even though roofs were always challenging for me (I know… I learned to climb in the Gunks and I don’t climb roofs often). Iris supported my send of Groovy (5.8) earlier that day, so I was hyped and ready to support her on Bonnie’s, ready to get worked. And that I did…
.
.
Iris fought and got through pitch 1 so well!! I followed up and flailed at the first roof a few times 😅😭🤣 Iris patiently helped me through with a haul and a tight belay. Totally worked… I looked over at the traverse. I belayed Iris over and was amazed at how exposed everything was in this corner. Iris crushed it once again and disappeared around the bend. I was really proud of us that day for pushing through. Thank you Iris for trusting me as your partner that day!!
.
.

I left the weekend reflecting that truly only at a space like Flash Foxy could I experience such a safe, gentle, queer environment to explore the whole spectrum of my being. From sweating my way up sandstone walls, to blushing during flirting class, to nerding out with other trans and nonbinary climbers from across the country, Flash Foxy really had it all. 
.
One of my favorite moments of the weekend was when after a long day of climbing and making cute new friends, one of the other participants offered to facilitate an impromptu flirting 101 meetup. The bashful, subtext-loving queer inside of me was swooning– this was the skillshare I needed. We received some beautiful advice that the best kind of flirting is just genuinely being interested in getting to know the other person, and asking them real questions to learn more. Wow, what a concept. We then practiced with one another, and the giggles and shyness blossomed into a massage train, which our bodies were all deeply craving after a long day of climbs.” - Scotty Brown (they/she), 2026 Scholarship recipient

Hey folks! Event Coordinator Marian May (they/them) for Mini Fest here to give you a nostalgic warm feeling in your heart today 💕 Not only is the Flash Foxy Mini Fest in the Gunks a full circle moment for the organization, but for myself and Lou to reconnect to this land we both learned how to climb on. 
.
If you didn’t know, Lou (our managing director @mostly_limbs ) and I both lived at the @gunkscampground right when Lou started working for Flash Foxy. I was living in my car for a few months already, feeling alone in my identity, alone in climbing, and overall struggling with community in a primarily white, cis passing rural area. Lou came through to live and work on their skills to take our Single Pitch Instructor exam together and I was forever grateful to have a comrade who understood what I was experiencing at the time. 
.
So much laughter, joy, sadness, tears, and fears were experienced on this land together. We taught the first Flash Foxy education course in the Gunks with @shelmatic, @katerinegrajales, and @riseoutsidecollective. We’ve taken and caught each other many times trying hard mentally and physically. I learned how to embrace my gender queerness and trans identity thanks to Lou. Got caught in the rain at the campground and on the cliff. Most of all, we learned to come back to the land and love everything this cliff has to offer. 
.
Flash Foxy is a small team of folks working on making spaces inclusive for many types of people. We embrace nuance and understand that being a climber can be a spectrum, from just starting in the gym to climbing trad in the Gunks. We work hard to convince brands and other entities that the spaces we create are necessary for building community. If it wasn’t for Flash Foxy and the Gunks, I wouldn’t be where I’m at today. 
.
Tickets for the Flash Foxy Mini Fest in the Gunks are live July 1st ⏰ ✨ Help us continue to bring Women and Genderqueer climbers together in rural areas and take up space 🌈 Let’s make the Gunks a little brighter October 2nd - 4th!!!
.
See you soon! xo @heyitsmayjay 
.
#flashfoxy

“I’m from a small town in Ohio, and the last time I line danced was during a middle school gym unit. Where I’m from pop country was always playing in the background, and I associated it with the racism that constantly simmered beneath the surface in my town. So when I saw line dancing at Flash Foxy, I approached it with real trepidation. 
.
It was amazing. Line dancing at Flash Foxy threw everyone out of their comfort zone. It was queer, multiracial, raucous, humbling, and exhausting. I connected with people I otherwise would never have spoken to, often through shared laughter.
.
More than anything, it showed me the beauty of being in a queer and multi-racial space, and how laughter and community allowed us to reclaim something that had once carried such a negative connotation for me.” - @Billyetoussaint (she/her), 2026 Scholarship Recipient
.

Top Things to Do in New Plymouth, Taranaki Region ,New Zealand 🇳🇿✨

1️⃣ TSB Festival of Lights is a must-see attraction in New Plymouth, transforming the city into a vibrant display of colour and creativity.✨ Dec 20th 2025 - January 24 2026.

2️⃣ Manganui Gorge Bridge, Mount Taranaki
The Manganui Gorge Bridge sits high on the slopes of Taranaki Maunga, reached by an easy 20-minute walk with truly breathtaking views.

Surrounded by rugged alpine scenery, it’s a place that feels both peaceful and dramatic @farmers_market_taranaki .

As conditions can be cold and windy, be sure to come prepared and take extra care on icy or slippery rocks🌿

3️⃣ Waverley Beach in the South Taranaki region is equally captivating, offering a stunning setting to capture summer sunrises and sunsets.

With golden light over the coastline and windmills dotting the horizon, it’s a perfect spot for photography and quiet moments by the sea.

4️⃣ Three Sisters & Elephant Rock, Tongaporutu Coast
These dramatic coastal rock formations are accessible only at low tide. Expect a little mud, but be rewarded with breathtaking coastal views and a truly unique experience 🌊

O Maracatu Feminino Coração Nazareno foi a primeira atração do Coquetel Molotov 2025, realizado neste sábado (6), na UFPE. Diretamente de Nazaré da Mata, na Zona da Mata Norte de Pernambuco, o grupo, único maracatu rural  formado exclusivamente por mulheres, apresentou um espetáculo carregado de cultura, política e resistência.✊

As integrantes mostraram a força de quem enfrenta, todos os dias, diversos bloqueios sociais para manter vivo o sonho e o desejo de ocupar espaços dentro da tradição.

A equipe da Manguetown Revista conversou com as mestras do maracatu e, ao longo da semana, você acompanha essas entrevistas aqui nas nossas redes 📲

This past weekend I had the honor of sharing a Breathwork & Sound session at the WanderYogi Festival in the beautiful ruins of Casa Paço d’Ilhas. 

The weather soft, the sun slowly setting, a group of curious and committed humans.. it was a dreamy session, powerful in its sweetness. 

Breathwork is often thought of as a trauma release modality - intense, loud,… It really doesn’t have to be. Though sometimes we can benefit from those cathartic releases, I don’t see it as a cure. For me the slower we go, the faster we heal. There is so much to be explored in the subtle layers between body, breath, mind and spirit - interwoven as one. There can be so much pleasure and joy, insights and deep understanding. 

It’s an infinite journey - that of the breath - and I’m grateful to be on it with all those who join me.

Looking forward to our next BREATH & SOUND CEREMONY @houseoftherisingmojo on Tuesday 21st of October !

DM if you’re curious to journey with me 🤗

Peace,

Marie🤍

Big thanks to @thewanderyogi_official , @casapacodilhas and everyone who came to create this beautiful festival together ! 🙏

✨ With full hearts, we close the 4th edition of the Wander Yogi Festival — another year of sharing our love for yoga, self-discovery, and connection.

By embracing the essence of the 8 limbs of yoga, we bring a little more consciousness into our everyday lives — in how we relate to ourselves, to others, and to the world around us.

In a time of such global unrest and pain, we can be deeply grateful for the community that reconnects us to our shared humanity — to the truth that the light within me is the same light within you. 🤍 Let’s continue to share it, and choose kindness in all that we do.

Lokah Samastah Sukhino Bhavantu
May all beings be happy and free. 🕊️

With gratitude,
Carlotta

In the lead up to Fresh Tracks in @darwinfringefestival we are sharing the inspiration and process behind creating these new dance works.

The Grey Panthers Generating Divergence team with Kelly Beneforti and David McMicken are busy creating a work that explores the capabilities, stories and cultural differences of dancers in the Ageing Body.

This work has been developed through improvisational scores, storytelling, writing, and visuals. It tracks five generations, exploring time and how moments are kept in our bodies.

A rare creative space for seniors, this ensemble is now in its fourth year.

Kabar duka datang dari sosok yang wajahnya mungkin udah nggak asing buat generasi yang tumbuh di era download MP3. Amaludin Syarif, pria yang dikenal lewat fotonya di berbagai cover lagu MP3, dikabarkan meninggal dunia pada Kamis (15/10) di usia 46 tahun.

Jauh sebelum era streaming, wajah Amaludin sering muncul di koleksi lagu yang diunduh lewat internet. Ceritanya berawal dari kebiasaannya mengoleksi musik dan menyimpan file di 4Shared dengan foto dirinya sendiri sebagai cover. Tanpa disangka, file-file tersebut tersebar luas dan membuat wajahnya begitu familier bagi banyak orang, meski namanya baru dikenal belakangan.

Selamat jalan, “Mas-mas StafaBand”. Terima kasih udah jadi bagian dari kenangan kecil di masa-masa digging lagu MP3. 🤍

Di antara bangunan yang runtuh dan jalanan yang dipenuhi puing.  Scene skateboarding masih terus berjalan di Gaza. Lewat Skateboarding in Gaza (2026) by Hamza Daher yang di-share @boysofarabia, kita bisa liat bagaimana @gaza_skate_team masih di atas papan, mencoba berbagai trik, dan menikmati kebersamaan di antara reruntuhan. 

Buat Gaza Skate Team, skateboarding udah jadi bagian dari keseharian mereka selama bertahun-tahun. Sampai akhirnya konflik yang terjadi di sana merenggut banyak hal, termasuk skatepark,  hingga tempat yang dulu jadi ruang mereka berkumpul. Sekarang, potongan beton dan jalanan yang tersisa jadi tempat mereka kembali bermain. Skateboard mungkin nggak bisa mengubah keadaan atau mengembalikan apa yang sudah hilang. Tapi setiap kali papan itu melaju, masih ada kebersamaan, dan rasa bebas yang bisa mereka nikmatin.
